title: A new phone view: one project at a time
text: The phone view is being rebuilt around one project at a time. A slim top bar names the project and switches it, and it stays in place when a card is open. A box shows how many agents are at work and on which cards. The project's cards follow in sections (Queued, Planned, then Parked and Done), twenty at a time. A floating bar at the bottom keeps a new card within reach of the thumb. For now the new view is a preview under ?view=phone-next, next to the current phone view.
